entries.text: What we know right now is that the plane designated as flight 549... Lost radio contact tonight at 1900 hours edt, and subsequently crashed into a wooded area... Approximately 30 Miles from Albany, New York. Local law enforcement and emts have been on the scene... For just under two hours, but initial reports are they've found no survivors yet... Of the 134 passengers and crew listed on the manifest. I wish I could tell you that we had more information about the crash site, but darkness and the terrain are gonna make it pretty slow going until morning. We have a tape of the last radio exchange... Before 549 went down, which we're gonna play. But I want to stress the need to keep everything... You know or learn within the go team... So that all information to the press... Comes from the I.I.c. You cued up, John?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: Ready.
entries.speaker: John

entries.text: Copy, tower. Please advise. Do you see a need to adjust?
entries.speaker: Pilot

entries.text: Negative, 549. Steady air speed of two-niner-six knots. Maintain heading one-zero-zero at two-niner thousand feet. Go ahead, 549.
entries.speaker: Tower

entries.text: [ beeping on tape ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: What the hell is this?
entries.speaker: Pilot

entries.text: 549, do you read?
entries.speaker: Tower

entries.text: We've got something-- some intercept. My God! My God! Mayday! Mayday! Mayday!
entries.speaker: Pilot

entries.text: And that's all she wrote. Controllers tried to raise 549 on all available frequencies, but the pilots did not respond. Okay, we've got an faa charter leaving in one hour. Accommodations--
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: Excuse me, sir. I'm agent Mulder with the FBI. Is there any indication or suspicion that flight 549 may have been forced down?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Forced down?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: You can hear the pilot say "intercept" on the recording.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We have absolutely no data to support that. No confirmation of other aircraft in the area. Unless you have something.
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: No. No. But there was a passenger on that plane... Who was well-known to our government as an alien abductee.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ murmuring ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: An alien abductee?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: A man named Max Fennig. A multiple-abduction victim. What's known as a repeater.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ murmuring continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Hold on a second. Please. Can I have some quiet.
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: He predicted the accident. From the sound on the tape, the plane may have been forced down.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Forced down by who, or what?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: I'm hesitant to speculate.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder-- your name's Mulder?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: Yes, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Let me tell you something. I've been doing this for 18 years. I thought I'd heard everything.
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: I'm looking through the manifest here, and there was no one named Max fannig on flight 549.
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: Fennig. And there may be people who want to cover up this evidence.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, is this an official FBI position?
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: No, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Because what you're suggesting trivializes this tragedy... And casts these fine people and the work they have to do... In a light that I think you'd be well-advised to avoid.
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: I think we all share the same goal here, sir, and that's to find out what caused that plane to crash.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And if any of the capable men and women in this room... Find dr. Spock's phaser or any green alien goo, [ murmuring, chuckling ] we'll be sure to give you all the credit.
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: [ chuckles ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: All right then.

entries.text: They think it hit the ground at over 300 Miles an hour on an almost vertical descent. Meteorological data is being collected and analyzed, and so far they are attributing the crash to weather phenomena, to a rapid depressurization caused by a lightning strike... Or by something called a wind rotor coming off the adirondacks.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: But not to Max Fennig.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, even if he was on this flight, looking at this, he'd be in a hundred pieces. They're gonna be lucky if they can ID half the bodies they find here.

entries.text: Yeah.

entries.text: It's gotta be a mistake.

entries.text: Nine minutes, Scully. Do you remember the last time you were missing nine minutes?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ sighs ] Mulder, no one even reported the plane on radar. These guys are just going off of estimates until they can recover the data recorder.

entries.text: We need to know what that was, Sharon. If you're withholding any information, there could be severe consequences.

entries.text: Mulder?

entries.text: Man's name was larold Rebhun. The manifest has him listed in seat 13-d, which is the aisle seat right here. My guess is that Max Fennig was in 13-f, window seat. But the manifest has a passenger in that seat as a--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Paul gidney. It's an alias Max Fennig used in his letters when he went underground. He had many aliases, in fact, one of which he used to get a job... At the rocky flats environmental energy site in colorado... Where they handle and store uranium 235 and weapons-grade plutonium.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do you think Max was carrying plutonium?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, the burns on that passenger's face were deep-tissue radiation burns. I don't know how else he might have gotten them.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What would Max be doing with that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I don't know. I mean, he wrote hundreds, maybe even a thousand letters describing his abductions, but beginning in january, he started making vague references to a theft. Now, it seems to me from reading it that he started to get the idea... That he'd come on to something that was very dangerous.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: So what caused this crash?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: If he was carrying fissile plutonium, Mulder, and it became exposed in the cabin, it very conceivably could have caused the crash.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You want to know what I think, Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ instrument clicking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'm gonna tell you. I think Max was abducted, sucked right out of this door at 29,000 feet, and the burns we're seeing are a result of that abduction.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And all the evidence will point to this conclusion, but it will be dismissed because of its improbability, its unthinkability.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The crash of flight 549 will go unsolved unless we prove it. When Max is returned, he's going to tell us the same story unless someone gets to him first.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, Max is returned. I found out a few minutes ago. They found his body a short way from the wreckage earlier today.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You're positive of this?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Traveling under the name paul gidney, seat 13-f, with the same burns as his seat mate.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: There's still no explanation for this crash.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: But you guys are willing to make a determination as to whether there was an explosion.... Pre-impact or as we can see-- [ continues, indistinct ] but the data only points to an explosion... After the aircraft-- [ continues, indistinct ]
entries.speaker: Mike Millar

entries.text: Did you make a positive ID on Max Fennig? Well, they've located the cockpit voice recorder... And the flight data recorder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And the I.I.c. Is making a statement to the press... Saying that there was a complete systems malfunction on the plane.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: In other words, there's still no explanation for what brought this plane down.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, not yet, but they are taking a careful look at the emergency exit door. And while they cannot explain the radiation readings, they are not ready to attribute it as the direct cause.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They're not able to, or they're not willing to?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, why can't you just accept the facts?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Because there are no facts. What they're telling you, what they're gonna report, they're the opposite of facts. A claim to ignorance of the facts. Claimed steadfastly, ignorance becomes as acceptable as the truth.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What would you like them to report?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That there is not one wristwatch on any of those bagged bodies. The watches have been stolen.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Are you accusing these men of covering evidence?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: These men? No. These men are trained to identify moving parts-- hydraulics, electronics. They're trained to reconstruct those parts in the past and arrive at the present. But they can't do that because somebody has stolen the past from them. Nine minutes of it. Nine minutes that became a lifetime... For those passengers and now for their families. Someone has got to figure out what happened in those nine minutes. Somehow, we've got to get that back.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.text: Yes, sir. I know it by heart. At 19:52, flight 549 dropped from an altitude of 29,000 feet. About 45 seconds later, we got an altitude reading of triple-x. I've never seen anything like it. Hope to never again.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.

entries.location: VON DREHLE AIR FORCE ·  RESERVE INSTALLATION ·  9:37 A.M.
